_doc: San Diego's chain as data for tools/ship_track.sh (V3-PLAN P1, Lariat plan). tools/ship_sd.sh stays the chain of record (not a shim); this file reproduces its step sequence, re-synced 2026-10-13 to ship_sd.sh after ledger 0046 and v0.18.0 (0052: the race gate OBJ extracted before the AI writer + verify_ai_line; 0050: verify_fold_fans after the race gates; 0046 integration fix round: deck_datum first, ground_release after the triangulation, the I-8 pavement inside prep_prep before the split; 2026-10-26 ledger 0054 P4: the rock faces inside prep_prep after the I-8 pavement, the building caches and the sandstone tile synced in) (tiered terrain: terrain_sample / terrain_resample around the trim, triangulate_terrain after the seat, slim_far_terrain retired, the road gate OBJ before the track folder, the 3DEP cache + I-8 corridor synced in and out); tests/tools/test_ship_track_chain.py diffs the step headers. The assembler runs from tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/scripts-v021 through V021_SHIM, as in ship_sd.sh. engine-july runs the prep / exporter / spawn builder for this track only (tools/ship_track.sh decides that from the track name; ENG=<dir> points it at a scratch copy, as in ship_sd.sh; no key here can). 2026-11-03, ledger 0065 (v4 is Lake Murray's line): this file is v4's chain of record (tools/ship_sd.sh stays the 0.19.x chain: v4 = its steps + the terrain thin, the red repairs, the street-only kn5, the bespoke blocks and the house gate); draft 'bespoke' stands the buildings pipeline's blocks where ship_sd.sh's SD_BESPOKE=1 rehearsal did, gate 'houses' holds the built road kn5 to v4's 7,600 blocks, sync_in.assets brings the house textures engine-july lacks, and every prep input that lived only in the workshop (red_repairs.plan.json, terrain.tiers.json.gz, terrain.refine.json.gz, bridges.cache.json) and the draft's caches now cross both ways.
